notes:
### Changed

- **Agent messages: a send says only whether it was delivered.** `send_message` and `start_session` now answer `delivered: true`, `false` with the reason when nothing was sent, or `null` with the reason when the client may have taken the words without saying so. `get_message` and the `reply_hint` argument are gone: the other session answers with `send_message` and `reply_to`, and its reply arrives in the sender's session as a new turn, so there is nothing to poll. A session without Agent HUD's tools can no longer answer a message. Agents that still call `get_message` get an unknown-tool error; start a new session so they read the new tool list.

### Fixes

- `send_message` no longer reports "The local tools response did not complete" for a message that did go out, which made the sender send it again. When the answer is late, Agent HUD is asked what became of that very call and the agent gets the real result; one call never sends twice. A slow send also no longer holds up the other sessions of Antigravity or DeepSeek Harness, which share one connection to Agent HUD (#118, thanks @zqy5618).
- Quotas are read sooner after you use them: 5–15 seconds after the last turn that spends a quota ends, and every 3 minutes otherwise, whether or not the plan is also used on another device. Codex, Cursor and several others used to wait up to 4 minutes after a turn, and an idle Claude could go hours unread (#135, thanks @Kki1ds).
- A HUD on the right or bottom edge no longer jumps aside when its panel starts to open or blinks after it closes (#129, Windows, thanks @xiaofanghao).
- A HUD on the right edge is on the screen again. Since 0.6.5 it sat beyond the edge, out of sight and out of reach of the pointer (Linux, X11).
